title: Ultramock launch: Make your app. World-class.
summary: A 30 s pitch-black launch reel for a 3D mockup/animation tool. Short white sans statements ('Make your app / website / content', 'World-class', 'Production-grade 3D', 'Advanced timeline', 'Connect to AI') sit left or centre while macro, shallow-depth-of-field 3D renders of phones, watches, laptops and the app's own timeline UI drift past behind them. Apple-keynote restraint: black, glossy hardware, slow camera, one word changes at a time.
fit_reason: The black-canvas, one-phrase-at-a-time keynote cadence and macro shots of the product's own UI suit a premium SaaS launch, but it relies on 3D device renders SaaSSuite doesn't have yet.

palette.mood: dark premium Apple-keynote, glossy device highlights, small hits of orange-red from the app UI

typography.display: SF Pro Display / Inter semibold, tight tracking
typography.size_behaviour: medium (~5% height), left-aligned over imagery or centred alone on black
typography.notes: 'World-class' set in chrome/metallic gradient fill with glitch; end wordmark 'ULTRAMOCK' in a wide outlined techno/stencil face, small and centred.

text_animation: word-swap: 'Make your' stays fixed while the last word blurs out and the next ('app', 'website', 'content') blurs in
words reveal left-to-right with per-word blur-to-sharp and opacity
chrome text with brief RGB-split glitch on entry
statements fade/blur out with slight scale-down
motion: slow macro dolly and orbit around 3D phones/watch/laptop with very shallow depth of field
UI screens tilted in perspective and drifting (parallax between panels)
camera glides along the app's timeline UI with keyframe diamonds and orange playhead
fish-eye surreal environment shot (phone on a column in a painted landscape) as a pattern break
grid of template thumbnails slides diagonally
transitions: hard cut to bright colour scene for contrast
graphic_elements: app editor UI with timeline, keyframes, sliders
ui_treatment: real product UI shot as tilted macro crops with depth of field, plus product renders inside 3D device mockups

sound.music: cinematic ambient electronic with swells and soft impacts
sound.sync: text swaps on the downbeat of slow phrases

signature_moves: fixed lead-in phrase with a rotating last word ('Make your app / website / content')
macro shallow-DOF orbit around product UI and devices on pure black
one short phrase per beat, nothing else on screen
chrome glitch type for the single 'brag' word

best_segments.what: 'Make your ___' word swap over tilted macro UI and device shots
Camera glides along the timeline UI: 'Advanced timeline' then 'Or keep it simple', then 'Connect to AI' on black
Black beat with chrome glitch 'World-class', then macro laptop UI and 'Pro'

recreate.how: Text layer easy in HTML+GSAP or Remotion (word swap with blur). Device/UI shots need 3D renders (Blender/Spline/Rotato) or AI video of screen recordings mapped onto devices; a cheaper version uses 2.5D: product screenshots on CSS 3D-transformed planes with blur DOF and slow camera drift.
recreate.prompt: Pure black #000000; slow macro dolly across glossy 3D phone and laptop showing the product UI with shallow depth of field; left-aligned white semibold 'Make your app' where the last word blurs and swaps; single chrome glitch word 'World-class'; orange-red #e84a24 playhead on a timeline; calm cinematic ambient score.
